posts.title: Windows 11 Is Collecting Data on Which Coding Agents and Developer Tools You Use
posts.description: I recently asked AI to help me look through the latest Windows binaries for undocumented features and functionality. Among the leads it turned up, one list immediately caught my attention: coding agents such as codex.exe , claude.exe , copilot.exe , and cursor.exe , alongside familiar developer tools such as python.exe , dotnet.exe , gcc.exe , and code.exe . posts.description: LG has been under fire for what its devices do after people buy them. posts.title: Detecting Insecure Software Updates at Scale with LLM Agents
posts.description: TL;DR I used a hierarchy of low-cost source-reading agents, stronger review agents, and manual verification to trace how 3,006 open-source projects handle software updates. I found 624 with an updater that could download and then install, load, or execute code: 134 used a pinned signing key, 109 enforced a publisher identity, 332 relied only on HTTPS, and 49 used broken transport security .
